profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A black ledger with bronze corners opens too neatly, as if the pages have already decided what the facts will be.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A garment of thousands of tiny polished stones moves like cloth and turns thorns like armor. Every fitted piece looks cut by hands that loved the work.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.alt: Bramble Ward-Scrap Charm Cluster item illustration.
profile_image.player_caption: A knot of blue ward shards, twine, and tiny salvage tags clacks softly at a Bramblefolk belt. It looks illegal only because it looks useful.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A fat red-orange berry shines a little too perfectly, with a tiny insect suspended dead-center like a pit in amber. It looks appetizing and deeply wrong.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A short serrated blade shows careful filing along the back edge and a handle wrapped in road cord. It is ugly in the practical way of a tool that has never had a decorative day.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A cheap little ward charm sits cracked down the middle, still trying to glow through a smiling warranty sticker.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A round shield of overlapping slick green-grey scales catches the light like river-water. It smells of deep water, mud, and old teeth.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A strong golden liquor sloshes in a thick jug, warm going down and warmer staying there. A paper tag insists it is not made from grapes and is absolutely not medicinal.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A heavy brass chit with a smiling coin-face drops into your palm like a tiny verdict. The fine print is too small to read without feeling blamed.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A flat brass disc on a post holds a watchful glyph and a single cheerful bell. When trouble happens nearby, the glyph lights, the bell rings once, brightly, and then nothing else happens at all.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A laminated badge shows a flattering but wrong portrait under a peeling CERTIFIED stamp. It somehow looks proud of the mistake.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: Inside the sealed crate, packed in wax-paper and reassurance, sits a heavy grey stone the size of a loaf, warm to the touch, faintly humming, with a light deep inside it that is slowly going out.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A corked bottle glows moonlit blue from inside, even in daylight, even in your pack. The water looks calm enough to sell itself.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A smooth grey pebble feels warm and ordinary until it refuses to stay where you put it. Set it down, look away, and it waits back in your palm.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A little painted tin holds fine black ash and a folded promise as long as your arm. It smells of old smoke and expensive confidence.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: Warm amber sap beads from a crack in a huge trunk like the tree is breathing it out. It smells of honey, woodsmoke, and something older.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: Growing straight up out of dark forest soil, like a sapling that decided to be a sword, is a blade of living dark wood and pale metal. It has no maker's mark and hums when your hand nears the hilt.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A pair of shoes sewn entirely from broad sablewood leaves sits light as breath, green-veined, and already leaning toward motion.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A heavy ring of mismatched brass keys and blue-glass tags chimes with a sound like distant bells heard through rain.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A small thumb-polished token on a cord hangs beside the torn blue scarf, warm from wear and etched with a tiny house mark instead of a company seal.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A small stoppered vial holds fine grey-green thorn powder that seems to drink the light. A blade edge near it looks sharper and hungrier.

profile_image.label: Item profile image
profile_image.player_caption: A small hand-carved wooden ratcoon mid-scamper has been thumb-worn smooth for luck. It is warm, and the forest feels a little kinder while you hold it.
